events.title: Oasis' 'Definitely Maybe' turns 32
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994, featuring anthems like 'Supersonic' and 'Live Forever'.

angles.name: Britpop Classic
angles.copy: Cast your mind back to '94, when Oasis dropped their debut 'Definitely Maybe'. Instantly a game-changer, it defined an era and gave us some absolute bangers. Which track still gets you going?

events.title: Woodstock Festival's 57th anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, kicked off on August 15, 1969, in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Peace, Love & Music
angles.copy: 57 years ago, a field in New York became the epicentre of a generation. Woodstock wasn't just a festival; it was a cultural phenomenon. Imagine being there!

events.title: Anniversary of Elvis Presley's passing
events.blurb: August 16, 2026, marks 49 years since the world lost the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: It's 49 years since the music world fell silent for Elvis Presley. His legacy as the King of Rock and Roll is undeniable. What's your all-time favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Anniversary of Tupac Shakur being shot
events.blurb: On September 7, 1996, hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur was tragically shot in a drive-by incident in Las Vegas, succumbing to his injuries six days later.

angles.name: Hip-Hop Legend
angles.copy: A quarter-century on, the music world still remembers the tragic night in Las Vegas when Tupac Shakur was shot. His impact on hip-hop remains monumental.

events.title: Anniversary of Jimi Hendrix's passing
events.blurb: September 18, 2026, marks 56 years since the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix tragically passed away in London.

angles.name: Guitar God Remembered
angles.copy: 56 years ago today, we lost a true trailblazer. Jimi Hendrix redefined the electric guitar and left an indelible mark on music. His influence is still felt today.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in the UK on September 26, 1969, featuring iconic tracks like 'Come Together' and 'Something'.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: That zebra crossing. That album. The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' is 57 today! A masterpiece from start to finish. What's your favourite track from it?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' legendary frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday on September 7, 2026.

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! A true rock icon, still fronting The Pretenders with that unmistakable voice and attitude.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock 'n' roll star, Liam Gallagher, celebrates his 54th birthday on September 21, 2026.

angles.name: Mad Fer It Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid's another year older! Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still bringing the rock and roll swagger. LG x

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album turns 55 (UK)
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal solo album 'Imagine' was released in the UK on October 8, 1971, featuring the iconic title track.

angles.name: A Song For Peace
angles.copy: 55 years ago, John Lennon gave the world 'Imagine'. An album that still resonates with its message of peace and unity. What does the title track mean to you?

events.title: First iPod released 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising how people listened to music.

angles.name: Tech That Changed Music
angles.copy: Remember life before streaming? 25 years ago, the first iPod dropped and changed everything. Suddenly, thousands of songs were in your pocket.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the release date of the very first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, 007 has been a cinematic icon for decades. Who's your favourite Bond?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Music legend and co-founder of The Beatles, John Lennon, would have celebrated his 86th birthday on October 9, 2026.

angles.name: Remembering A Legend
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the visionary John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday on October 27, 2026.

angles.name: Comedy Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! A true titan of British comedy, from Python to Fawlty Towers.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968, showcasing their diverse musical styles.

angles.name: A Blank Canvas of Sound
angles.copy: It's 58 years since The Beatles unveiled their 'White Album'. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece that proved they could do anything. What's your hidden gem from it?
